    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: role="group" named by the title and described by the description and the countdown
      - listitem: Real buttons with aria-keyshortcuts; the kbd hints are aria-hidden
      - listitem: "The decision is announced through a polite live region (\"Approved: Send campaign email\")"
      - listitem: The countdown has a full text description ("Expires in 24 seconds unless approved…") linked via aria-describedby; the visible clock is aria-hidden so it isn't read every second, and it pauses while the card is hovered or focused
      - listitem: While an approval is processing the card is aria-busy and the buttons are aria-disabled, so focus is never lost
      - listitem: After a decision focus moves to the resolved row (tabIndex -1) if it was inside the card
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: On a decision the card and its tray footer fade and blur out, the height glides down to a compact row inside the tray and the check or cross draws itself in
      - listitem: The countdown text ticks down once per second without animation and turns amber in the last 10 seconds
      - listitem: Buttons press in slightly; the checkbox tick scales in
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly and only the spinner keeps turning slowly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container; below 400px card width the buttons share a full-width row and the shortcut hints hide
      - listitem: Below 340px the risk badge drops the word "risk" and the resolved row drops its time
      - listitem: Titles, descriptions and detail values truncate instead of wrapping; works down to 320px
      - listitem: Shortcut hints are hidden on touch screens
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Render one card per pending tool call that needs consent; resolve the tool call with the onApprove / onDeny result
      - listitem: Return the real execution promise from onApprove so the card stays locked until the action has actually started
      - listitem: "Persist { always: true } per tool name and skip the card next time"
      - listitem: "Set risk from the action, not the model's confidence: anything external, paid or irreversible is at least medium"
      - listitem: Keep title an imperative verb phrase and put the concrete values (recipients, amount, target) in details
